But in the water, it's backwards.
The reflection is backwards — try again

See? If you wait, everything comes back.

entries.ko: 돌이 튄 횟수만큼의 시각에 쏜 탄을 부표에 맞히세요

entries.ko: 숫자 연잎 — 연잎 숫자와 같은 시각 탄으로 맞히면 피어나요

All the lily pads bloomed — the shadows scatter
The lily pads close up again
I'm sure... I came in through a door...

entries.ko: 노을...... 이렇게 따뜻한 색은 처음 보는군.

This clock stopped at three o'clock.

entries.ko: 얘야, 광장 시계는 혼자선 못 고쳐.
entries.en: Little one, you can't fix the Plaza Clock alone.

entries.ko: 거리의 시계는 믿지 마라. 저건 늘 제멋대로니까.
entries.en: Don't trust the street clocks. They always do as they please.

entries.ko: 바닥 바늘이 멈춘 숫자에 서서, 발사 시각을 맞춰라

entries.ko: 연기 사이로 지나가면 돼. 틈은 늘 있으니까.

Slip through the gaps in the smoke rings
You came. The train leaves soon.
I'll be back soon. I promise.
No... not yet. Just a little longer.

entries.ko: ...뭐든 상관없어. 이 기차는 아직 못 보낸다.
entries.en: ...Don't care what it is. This train ain't leavin' yet.

First things first. Deal with what's right in front of me.

Every shot you fire moves time forward,
and as time passes, you might gain

entries.ko: 탄에 마우스를 올리면 시각 조건과 지금 판정 시각을 볼 수 있어요.
entries.en: Hover over a bullet to see its hour condition and current Judgment Hour.

entries.ko: '{0}'이 활성화되면 양옆 칸 탄의 판정 시각이 +{1} 돼요. 연산을 다 계산한 다음에 더해져요.

Hah, ain't lost my touch yet!

entries.en: <color=#FFD54A>Operator</color> Door: get Operators that change a bullet's Judgment Hour.

entries.ko: 연산은 탄에 끼워 판정 시각을 바꾸는 계산이에요.
entries.en: Operators are calculations you slot into a bullet to change its Judgment Hour.

entries.ko: 탄을 다른 칸으로 옮기지 않아도 조건을 맞출 수 있어요.
entries.en: You can meet a condition without moving the bullet to another slot.
Click a bullet to open the 'Bullet Upgrade' window.

entries.ko: 보관함의 연산을 이 칸으로 끌어 끼우면 돼요.
entries.en: Drag an Operator from Storage into this slot.
<size=22>The basic 'Plain Round' has no Operator Slot.</size>

entries.en: The Judgment Hour starts at the slot's hour, then applies Operators from the top down.
Swap the order and it's 3 → +1 → 4 → ×2 → 8 o'clock.
Uneven division rounds off. e.g. Slot 5 ÷2 → 2.5 → 3 o'clock

entries.en: Results above 12 or at 0 and below stay as they are. e.g. Slot 9 ×2 → 18 o'clock · Slot 1 −2 → −1 o'clock

entries.en: So you can even meet conditions like 'negative hour'.

Smell of medicine... I know it.
...That thing's been watchin' me from the start.
...The shadows are closin' in on the bed.

entries.en: Hit the target by the wall clock with a bullet matching the hour it shows

entries.ko: 링거가 떨어질 때마다 시간이 새요 — 모래시계를 주워 버티세요
entries.en: Time leaks with every IV drip — grab hourglasses to hold on

entries.en: Number Seals — fire that hour's bullet, then stand on the seal (in order)
Were there always this many clocks?
I want to hear it just once more.

entries.en: In the order they glowed, hit each clock with a bullet whose hour matches its number

entries.ko: 톱니 숫자와 같은 시각 탄으로 쏘면 돌아가요
entries.en: Shoot a gear with a bullet whose hour matches its number to turn it
The gear stopped again — try again

entries.ko: 문자판이 뒤섞여요 — 내 발사 시각 숫자 칸에 서세요
entries.en: The dial shuffles — stand on the number of your Firing Hour

entries.en: Any further... and she's truly gone.
I went down. I'm sure of it.
You always come back at the same hour.

entries.ko: 여긴 바늘이 열두 시에 닿지 않는 곳이야.
entries.en: Here, the hands never reach twelve.

entries.ko: 그러니 몇 번을 쓰러져도 다시 일어나지.
entries.en: So no matter how often you fall, you rise again.
I... gotta get outta this village...
...Why? Why do the same thing over and over?
If you must, then go out that way.

entries.ko: 하고 나서 후회하는 게 아무것도 하지 않는 것보단 나을 테니...
entries.en: Regretting what you did is better than doing nothing at all...
I looked for you so long...

entries.ko: 네가 쓰러진 뒤로 저렇게 멈춰 버렸어...
entries.en: Ever since you fell, they've stood still like that...
Go find the others. Ask them how to fix it.

entries.ko: 그리고 널 위해 방을 하나 마련해 두었으니 올라가 봐.
entries.en: And I made up a room for you. Go on up.
I was... at that train station, I swear...
You're awake...you must have gone far...
Anyway, more new guests have come.
Maybe they can fix the clock.
(Broke again? Can't make heads or tails of this)
Don't look at me with those doubting eyes
In the end, the reason this clock stops is...
Never mind.. you'll learn in time
Was the Inn... always on the left?
Ah, come to think of it, a guest seems to have arrived.....
Why not pay them a visit.
I've lost count of how many times we've met....

entries.ko: 하지만 그런건 이 곳에선 중요하지 않지.

Fashion always matters, even for an outlaw.
